name: Schema.org Education
description: Adds the Schema.org EducationalOccupationalProgram type as Schema Metatag properties, contributing its vocabulary to Schema Metatag's JSON-LD output.
project_description:
This module provides one Schema.org type as a Schema Metatag group:

- EducationalOccupationalProgram

Requirements: Schema.org Metatag (schema_metatag).

Usage: enable the module, go to Administration > Configuration > Search and metadata > Metatags (/admin/config/search/metatag), select an entity type/bundle, expand the "Schema.org: EducationalOccupationalProgram" fieldset and map the properties you want to publish. Schema Metatag assembles and renders the JSON-LD.
